raw_definitions: Definisi : n ( lit. & fig. ) pasport: he has to renew his ~ soon, dia harus membaharui pasportnya tdk lama lagi; a young writer always hopes that his next novel will be his ~ to fame, penulis muda sentiasa berharap novelnya yg seterusnya akan menjadi pasport utk mencapai kemasyhuran.
